answer: Because the nectar collateral is checked against the vault claim at intake, the quill audit records the ratio and an under-collateralised submission is refused. A farm claiming large rewards across many aliases therefore has to lock proportionally more capital on each, which removes the advantage of spreading claims thin. Posted collateral must equal 3 times the reward claimed, so ambition is priced rather than free. That is 34 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
